exposure: Colour Doppler ultrasound parameters (Umbilical Artery Systolic/Diastolic (S/D) ratio, Pulsatility Index (PI), Resistance Index (RI))
Middle Cerebral Artery (MCA) PI and RI
cohort: The study included 124 pregnant women identified as high-risk based on specific criteria.
finding: Colour Doppler ultrasound is a valuable tool in managing high-risk pregnancies, as abnormal Doppler parameters are strong predictors of adverse perinatal outcomes.
followup_time: Up to the perinatal period (including outcomes like perinatal mortality and NICU admission)
